changes.result: Committed 5a8bcd65c7bc758be34d97be2a5e7b2d42b398f6 adding only crates/herder/src/application/context.rs. project_self_context reuses existing Writer lineage/messages/intents, requires verified self plus exact session Read ACL, returns IDs and original source timestamps only (no correspondence text), bounds recent senders at 8, and distinguishes creator missing and sender missing/complete/partial. Existing SQLite create/close/reopen fixture, recipient ACL denial, private-text exclusion and partial cap tests: 3 passed. Evidence: evidence/v044a-context-source-green.txt. Tests used temporary module export, removed before commit. Export hunk sent to Terra; no shared lib/Cargo/schema diff. Model-visible injection and runtime acceptance are not proven.
